summary.text: Frank Casella is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 21, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Ambureen Rana.
Casella works in construction and says he ran for the Bangor School Committee before seeking the House seat.

paragraphs.text: Frank Casella earned a high school diploma from Blair Academy, a bachelor's degree from East Stroudsburg University in 2008 and a graduate degree from the Philadelphia College of Osteopathic Medicine in 2014.
His career experience includes working in construction.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Casella said he and his wife moved to Bangor nine years ago after meeting in graduate school in Philadelphia, and that he ran for the Bangor School Committee before running for the Maine House.

He said he would bring a builder's mindset to the State House and listed lowering the cost of homeownership and electric power, raising reading and math proficiency, and addressing the drug trade as his goals.
